items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I put Roy Milton up there and I got Eddie Nicholson on drums.

ctx.x: Yes, Eddie Nicholson the drummer. And he said I kind of like your band and everything (inaudible).

So Roy Milton, I had a talk with him and I told Roy, I said Roy, I'm still with you, I says, but I'm going to put you in front of the band, so you know you're all right with me, and so I put him like they called the entertainment. I put Roy Milton up there and I got Eddie Nicholson on drums.
Do you know the approximate date and how you were at that time?
